{{Top|leg}}
The '''Confederation Rock Rush''' was an event that occurred in about [[31 BBY/Legends|31 BBY]] when the [[Smugglers' Confederation|Smuggler's Confederation]], led by the [[Oblee]] [[Nirama]], opened up the [[Cularin asteroid belt]] for exploration. [[Starship/Legends|Starships]] from all over the [[Cularin system/Legends|Cularin system]], such as the [[Transport/Legends|transport]] ''[[Daring]]'' flocked to take part. Some were damaged by the dangerous [[Asteroid/Legends|asteroids]] while others ended up fighting each other over claims to newly-discovered asteroids. The [[Heroes of Cularin]] participated and they discovered an asteroid containing a survivor of the [[Sibilaari]] species.
